description.value: Mark Twain was an American writer. He published books and was a popular and humorous speaker. His most famous novels are about Tom Sawyer and Huckleberry Finn. His real name was Samuel Langhorne Clemens. He was born in 1835 and lived to be 74 years old. He grew up on the Mississippi River in the southern United States. His family was poor.
